chars.SON: SON: a 20-year-old young man wearing a maroon hoodie with one white stripe across the chest, black jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother wearing a light green house djellaba with a small white floral pattern and a beige headscarf.
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan father wearing a brown wool djellaba over blue striped pyjamas and thin reading glasses.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Late at night in the entrance of a modest Moroccan apartment in a big city. SON stumbles in through the open front door, swaying and dizzy with half-closed eyes and a goofy grin, one sneaker untied. MOM and DAD stand in the hallway in front of him, frozen in shock, MOM with both hands on her cheeks, DAD with his mouth wide open. Comic, awkward moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan tiled bathroom. DAD holds SON, fully dressed and dripping wet, under the running shower while SON looks dazed; MOM stands at the bathroom door holding a towel, shaking her head in disbelief. Comic.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A simple Moroccan bedroom at night with a small window. SON lies on his bed in his damp maroon hoodie, dizzy, the room appears to spin around him (motion swirl lines), one arm hanging off the bed, regretful face.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same bedroom at night, lit by moonlight. SON sits on the edge of his bed holding his head in both hands, thinking hard, ashamed, his school books piled untouched on the desk next to him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Morning sunlight in the same Moroccan bedroom. SON wakes up in bed, eyes wide and surprised, because MOM and DAD are standing right next to his bed staring down at him with arms crossed and serious angry faces.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same bedroom, morning. DAD leans forward pointing an accusing finger at SON who sits in bed with the blanket pulled up to his chin, guilty; MOM beside DAD is crying and wiping her eyes with her headscarf.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan living room with traditional banquette sofas and a low round table full of food (bread, tea pot, msemen). MOM gestures with open arms toward the full table and a stack of school books, upset, as if saying you have everything; SON stands in front of her with his head down.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. SON sits on the banquette and suddenly bursts into tears, big tears streaming down his face; MOM and DAD stand beside him, surprised and confused, reaching out to him.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan clinic corridor with plastic chairs and a closed door to the doctor's office. DAD and MOM rush SON, who is weak and shaking with his arm over DAD's shoulder, toward the closed door; MOM looks very worried.
